summary: Restoration pledges include 70,000 ha of wetlands restored by 2030—about 19.7% of currently mapped wetland extent—100,000 ha each of natural-forest regeneration and degraded protected-forest restoration, and 2.5 million ha of restored forest landscape by 2030; a separate planted-forest series reaches 407,608, but its unit is not stated. Conservation pledges target 23 catchment plans and 100% climate-adaptation compliance for those plans by 2030, 25% of urban land as preserved parks or greenbelts, and 1.7 million tonnes/year of fish stock by 2030. Agriculture targets 1.3 million ha of agroforestry (≈11.1% of current agricultural land), 152,622 ha under irrigation, and 70.7% of farmers practising sustainable land management by 2030. Mixed measures target 12% wetland coverage and 21% forest cover by 2030, plus a 40-million-tree campaign, 4,100 km of wetland boundaries, 62 MCM of water storage, and varied mitigation contributions.
